reviews.text: A wonderful vet highly recommended

Took my 15 year old cat here for the first time today. I am so grateful to have found this wonderful vet clinic! From reception, to the doctor and assistant team, the whole experience was professional and easy. The vet was easy to talk to and the whole experience, which has been stressful in the past, was surprisingly great.

Had an amazing experience with Dr. Nicole Yu!
My pup an 85lb pitty who usually needs a sedation to be handle at the vet due to having so much anxiety around her past experiences, was handle with such kindness, calmness and care. It was nice to experience a clinic that didn’t treat her any differently because of her breed. Most of the time a vets first instinct is to pin her down and put a muzzle on her … when she is the sweetest kindness softest baby girl in the world. Shes just scared. This was so refreshing to experience!
You can really tell that Dr.Nicole Yu and her team loves what they do ! They all have such a kind and soft demeanour that their team puts animals at ease.

When I recently got a puppy, I knew I wanted Dr. Sailor to be her veterinarian. As soon as I found out she had joined Juno Veterinary Clinic, I immediately followed her. I had already been hearing wonderful things about Juno and had been considering making the switch, so discovering that my favourite vet was there made the decision easy.

My experience has been exceptional from start to finish. The entire team; from the reception staff and veterinary technicians to Dr. Sailor herself, has been warm, professional, and genuinely caring. I travel in from the suburbs specifically to visit Juno, and it is absolutely worth the drive every single time.

Dr. Sailor is everything you hope for in a veterinarian: transparent, honest, knowledgeable, and incredibly compassionate. She truly cares about her patients and their families, and I always feel confident that my animals are receiving the very best care. She has looked after my pets with such dedication and kindness over the years, and that level of trust is invaluable.

I can’t recommend Juno Veterinary Clinic highly enough. If you’re looking for a veterinary team that combines expertise with genuine compassion, this is the place to go.
The service here is next level. So grateful

Called to book an emergency spot for our dog, call was answered by an AI bot that booked a 6pm slot. Then got another call, this time from a person, who said actually they close at 530 so there would be no appt. No possibility of staying late, even for a new customer, even though it was their screw up, even though the dog was in bad shape. Guess they don't need new business.
Thank you for the 5 stars Felixtense!
Dr. Danica Watson took such good care of my boys!! So caring and affectionate! Incredibly knowledgeable!
Very profesional service, they took care of my dog in an excellent way!

I believe the best of Juno is their front desk customer service, specially the lady with the blonde hair and if you use the app and message them you can get a quick reply at anytime, which is great.

However, my first visit made me realize that if the weather is hot you dont wanna be inside the room neither do your pets, because it gets extremely hot and they don't have air conditioning. My cat was overheating and they didn't seem to care much so keep that in mind.

Also if they want to add anything extra to your bill besides the medication do not let them do it, as I got a diffuser for cats and some food that basically was a waste of money, specially the diffuser. I didn't need either of them, but they way the talked is to make you think they were small courtesy items or extras then when you go to pay you realize that they just wanna make the bill bigger.

Other than that Dr Adam was really kind and professional so the lady helping him. The way how they treated my cat was exceptional.

My second visit started well with a nice person at the front desk and then a doctor who I belive is good and know what they are doing regarding the patient but I would rather not have a conversation with them, you can be surprised with the difference in standards.

Anyway I am still thankful that they were open to change my appointment time almost in the last minute and overall is a nice place to bring your pet.

In addition if someone is wondering about the price, the medical consultation for a cat is around $129. Hope that info will help someone.

My dog Poppy had to be hospitalized at the ER at VCA for multiple nights for a serious issue. The 24/7 virtual care team at Juno has been so so helpful and empathetic throughout the entire process. I wouldn’t have been able to be at peace without their support getting though this whole ordeal. So happy to be with them ❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cannot say enough good things about Juno Vet Yaletown. The entire team is professional, compassionate, and genuinely cares about the well-being of their furry patients. The veterinarians took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answer all of our questions, and ensure we understood the treatment options available. Their kindness and patience made a stressful situation much easier to navigate. The receptionists are friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to go the extra mile. It's clear that everyone at Juno Vet truly loves animals and is dedicated to providing exceptional care.
Thank you to the entire team for the outstanding service and for treating our pet like family. I highly recommend Juno Vet to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary clinic.
Fantastic clinic and high level of service. They quote before doing any procedures and explain any questions. It’s clear they’re passionate for animals and care about our fur babies. Highly recommend
Appreciate the 5 stars Fernando!

If you ever need a new vet place, This is where the heat is at!!!!! Amazing staff, fear free, and so accommodating. My dog was so nervous when we showed up but one of the receptionists, Raya, I think was her name. She was so friendly and made us feel so welcome. I'm so grateful that I made the switch from my last vet clinic because this place really offers not only the expertise from the amazing technicians but also the overall experience from the friendly and charismatic front desk! I know you guys just opened, but you guys are killing it. Keep up the good work!!!💪
Great experience! All the staff members are prepared and professional.

Place is very pricey and I should share my experience. My trust level for vets is quite low because they seem to try to push a lot of things you don’t really need but I do typically go to Beach Avenue Animal Hospital (mainly for proximity). But, was curious about Juno because of the reviews and social media ads. We were seen by a temporary vet (first red flag) and got quoted over between $1,560-$2,231 for dental scaling and polish for my 43lb miniature Australian shepherd (and verbally mentioned it’d likely be at the high estimate), while being charged $440 just for bloodwork (after $100 discount on first visit). Asked ChatGPT if this price was reasonable in Vancouver and it said it was high, mostly because it’s a glitz and glamour vet. So, went back to Beach Avenue Animal Hospital and ended paying $689 for the dental procedure. Understand Juno’s pricing includes x-rays but still pricey. Use this information to help you decide what’s best for you.

DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! Me and my puppy came there as a new clients just to get his first vaccine, and when i was booking my appointment i mentioned that we just need a vaccine and that’s the purpose of the visit. Yes, clinic looks pretty and clean, but that’s not the main point, we ended up paying almost 500$ for the absolute healthy dog!!! They gonna make you pay for absolutely unnecessary services like: “trim his nails, teach you how to trim them(for additional price of course), do all possible exams that you absolutely don’t need, and then boom, you being charged triple than you expected while your dog already getting treatment, so there is no way back, you just gotta pay that. And that wouldn’t be a problem for me if my dog was sick and i wanted them to do their absolute best to check everything and find a problem, but i just wanted a vaccine! super overpriced “aesthetic” scam. do not go there

Thank you so so so so much for helping my cat today!! Went in as a new client for a recurring constipation issue with my cat, that has cost me hundreds and hundreds of dollars in the past. Juno was so compassionate, so helpful, and so affordable. They were so transparent and kind. My cat was in such good hands, and he’s doing so much better tonight at home after the expert care at Juno. I had no idea I could walk away from an emergency spending less than $200 - THANK YOU !

Thank you so much for your 5-star review Brian! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful that you chose us for your pet's care. Our team is dedicated to providing a positive experience for both pets and their families, and your feedback means a lot to us. We look forward to seeing you and little baby M again soon! 💚 …

We had such a wonderful experience here with our 15-year-old Siamese, James. He is a very scared boy, but Dr. Tris was incredible with him. She took things slowly, was so calm and gentle, and it was clear right away that she is a true cat lover. James did so well during his check-up because of the care and patience she showed him.
Dr. Tris’ coworker was also incredibly kind and calm, and the front desk staff were amazing and very welcoming. We never felt rushed, and Dr. Tris took the time to go over pricing with us so we could make an informed decision.
James got so many treats during the visit, and we even left with a goodie bag, which was such a sweet touch. This was by far the best experience we’ve had with any vet in the Vancouver area. Highly recommend!

amazing service. Our regular vet is in Whistler but we came in to have a large tick removed from our girl, as we wouldn't have been able to see our vet for a few more days.
We received amazing service from start to finish, very knowledgeable and friendly staff.
If we lived in the area full time, we would be very happy to have Juno as our regular veterinary clinic.
Thank you for the 5 stars Matteo!

I walked in at 8 am for an emergency my dog accidentally ate a bit of chocolate. They saw me right away and took great care of us. The doctor was super knowledgeable and had great bedside manners. The clinic looks really nice and the people at the front desk are super helpful too. Highly recommend!!

We took our dog here today from another dog biting him. Dr Tris S and Amy T were extremely professional and made it a very comfortable environment for our dog in a stressful time. Dr Tris was very thorough in explaining the situation and made sure all of our questions were answered. Amy T went above and beyond making sure our dog was comfortable and even gave him a blanket. We really enjoyed the experience and will be switching to them as our main vet.
Walked in and waited to ask a question with front desk and was stone cold ignored! Absurd experience.

I don’t have enough words to thank the entire team at this clinic, especially Dr. Danica Watson and Karla from the staff. We had to make the difficult decision to put our dog to sleep, and they were there for us the entire time. They treated us with so much empathy, patience, and respect, and made us feel supported during such a hard day. You can tell they truly love what they do. Thank you so much for taking care of her and us until the very end.

Brought my cat here this morning and she had a great time! Dr. Watson is so kind and she answered any questions I had and made Maggie feel so comfortable. Would highly recommend this Vet for anyone in the local area, it has such a welcoming environment and the transparent pricing is so helpful. Thank you! 😻 …
Appreciate the care and service from the clinic staff. My dogs are highly reactive, and they ensured they had a great first experience. Will definitely be back again, happy to have found my new vet!
The team was warm and welcoming from the moment we walked in. So glad to have found a vet we can truly trust! 💚 …
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Lori 💚 We’re really grateful for your support and happy to know you had a great visit with us! …
Such a great first visit to the new location. The staff were wonderful, knowledgeable and very welcoming.
Great service in Yaletown with an even better staff! 🐶 …
Beautiful spot, the staff are all absolutely lovely, very nice vibe. The staff were happy to answer all questions that were asked with lots of information.

We just switched to Juno. We had a great first visit at this clinic. The front desk was friendly and prompt. The vet and vet tech worked together throughout the appointment, were very thorough, and really listened to our concerns. The space itself is also beautiful and very welcoming.

Our pup Pepper had a fantastic first visit at Juno! The team was very friendly and I appreciated the thorough exam. The vet was also transparent with the pricing for optional/not strictly necessary procedures and that helped me make an informed decision.

I had such a good experience bringing my cat here. The staff were so friendly and caring from the moment we walked in, they made it feel really easy and stress free. The doctor was amazing too, super gentle and really helped put my mind at ease. I’m really glad I found this place.
Such a great clinic. The space is beautiful, and the team is lovely. Dr. Watson was very thorough with my geriatric kitty, and we have a plan I am comfortable moving forward with.

I recently brought all three of my pets to Juno Vet Clinic, and I can’t say enough great things about the experience!
My cats Frank and Charlie came in, and even Frank,  who gets very nervous at the vet, absolutely loved Dr. Tris. That says everything. The care and patience the team showed made what could have been a stressful visit genuinely wonderful.
My dog Siggy had also visited earlier in the week, and he’s told me how he really feels about the whole experience. When I ask him if he wants to go to the vet, he gets excited to return. He can’t wait for his follow up appointment.
I’m so happy to have found Juno Vet Clinic and am making it our permanent home for all three pets. Highly recommend to any pet owner looking for a compassionate, skilled team that truly puts animals at ease.
